    async function downloadCollection(list, button) {
        if (button.disabled) return;
        const label = button.textContent;
        button.disabled = true;
        button.textContent = T('Preparing PDF…');
        try {
            const response = await fetch('/api/method/soa_api', {
                method: 'POST', credentials: 'same-origin',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8', 'X-Frappe-CSRF-Token': frappe.csrf_token || '' },
                body: new URLSearchParams({ action: 'coll_pdf', list: list }).toString()
            });
            if (!response.ok || !(response.headers.get('content-type') || '').includes('application/pdf')) {
                let error;
                try { error = await response.json(); } catch (_) { error = { message: T('Something went wrong. Try again.') }; }
                throw error;
            }
            const blob = await response.blob();
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            const link = document.createElement('a');
            link.href = url;
            link.download = 'Daily_Visit_Collection.pdf';
            document.body.appendChild(link);
            link.click(); link.remove();
            setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 60000);
        } catch (error) { toast(errText(error), 'bad'); }
        finally { button.disabled = false; button.textContent = label; }
    }

        el.innerHTML = `<section class="soa-card soa-visit-download" aria-labelledby="soa-visit-download-title">
                <div><h2 id="soa-visit-download-title">${esc(T('Daily visit collection'))}</h2>
                <p>${esc(fdate(d.date))} · ${esc(T('{0} customers', items.length))}</p></div>
                <button type="button" class="soa-btn pri soa-visit-download-btn" data-a="cpdf" data-list="${esc(d.list.name)}">${esc(T('Download daily visit collection PDF'))}</button>
            </section>` + days + `
            <div class="soa-csum">
				<div class="soa-card"><small>${esc(T('To collect'))}</small><b>${money0(due)}</b><span>${esc(T('{0} customers', items.length))}</span></div>
				<div class="soa-card"><small>${esc(T('Collected'))}</small><b class="green">${money0(got)}</b><span>${due ? Math.round((got / due) * 100) + '%' : '—'}</span></div>
				<div class="soa-card"><small>${esc(T('Left to visit'))}</small><b class="${left ? 'amber' : 'green'}">${left}</b><span>${esc(T('of {0}', items.length))}</span></div>
			</div>
			${isToday ? '' : `<div class="soa-warnbar">${esc(T('This is the list for {0}. You can still update it for 3 days.', fdate(d.date)))}</div>`}
			<div class="soa-card soa-cpad soa-ctools">
				<div class="soa-cflt">${[['todo', 'To visit'], ['done', 'Done'], ['all', 'All']].map((f) => `<button type="button" class="soa-chipbtn ${C.filter === f[0] ? 'on' : ''}" data-flt="${f[0]}">${esc(T(f[1]))} · ${n(f[0])}</button>`).join('')}</div>
				<input class="soa-in" type="search" data-f="q" value="${esc(C.q)}" placeholder="${esc(T('Search customer'))}">
			</div>
			<div class="soa-clist2"></div>`;
		renderList();
	}

	function renderList() {
		const el = $root.querySelector('.soa-clist2');
		if (!el) return;
		const q = C.q.trim().toLowerCase();
		const rows = active().filter((it) => inFilter(it) && (!q || (it.customer_name + ' ' + it.customer).toLowerCase().includes(q)));
		if (!rows.length) { el.innerHTML = `<div class="soa-card"><div class="soa-empty"><b>${esc(T(C.filter === 'todo' ? 'Everyone on your list has a result' : 'Nothing here'))}</b></div></div>`; return; }
		el.innerHTML = rows.map(cardHtml).join('');
	}

	function cardHtml(it) {
		const open = C.open === it.name;
		return `<article class="soa-card soa-cc ${(it.result || it.note) ? 'done' : ''} ${open ? 'open' : ''}" data-card="${esc(it.name)}">
			<div class="soa-cc-h">
				<div class="soa-cc-n"><b>${esc(it.customer_name)}</b><small>${esc(it.customer)} · ${esc(it.sales_person)}</small></div>
				${it.phone ? `<a class="soa-cc-call" href="tel:${esc(it.phone)}" title="${esc(T('Call'))}">${ico('phone')}<span>${esc(it.phone)}</span></a>` : ''}
			</div>
			<div class="soa-cc-amt">
				<div><small>${esc(T('To collect'))}</small><b>${money(it.due_amount)}</b><span>${esc(T('older than {0} days · since {1}', C.data.collect_after_days || 60, fdate(it.oldest_date)))}</span></div>
				<div><small>${esc(T('Total outstanding'))}</small><b class="soft">${money(it.total_outstanding)}</b></div>
			</div>
			${it.last_update ? `<div class="soa-cc-last">${ico('clock')}<span>${esc(T('Last: {0}', it.last_update))}</span></div>` : ''}
			${(it.result || it.note) && !open ? `<div class="soa-cc-res"><span class="soa-b ${RES_CLS[it.result] || 'grey'}">${esc(T(it.result || 'Remark'))}</span>${it.collected_amount ? `<b>${money(it.collected_amount)}</b><small>${esc(T(it.payment_mode || ''))}</small>` : ''}${it.promise_date ? `<small>${esc(T('promised {0}', fdate(it.promise_date)))}</small>` : ''}${it.note ? `<small class="soa-cc-note">${esc(it.note)}</small>` : ''}</div>` : ''}
			<div class="soa-cc-form">${open ? formHtml(it) : `<button type="button" class="soa-btn ${it.note ? '' : 'pri'}" data-a="open" data-item="${esc(it.name)}">${esc(T(it.note ? 'Edit remark' : 'Add remark'))}</button>`}</div>
		</article>`;
	}

    function formHtml(it) {
        return `<div class="soa-cf">
            <label class="soa-cf-note">${esc(T('Remark'))}<textarea class="soa-ta" aria-label="${esc(T('Remark'))}" data-f="note" rows="3" maxlength="140" placeholder="${esc(T('Add a remark for the PDF (up to 140 characters)'))}">${esc(C.form.note || '')}</textarea></label>
            <div class="soa-cf-btns"><button type="button" class="soa-btn" data-a="cancel" ${C.busy ? 'disabled' : ''}>${esc(T('Cancel'))}</button>
            <button type="button" class="soa-btn pri" data-a="save" ${C.busy ? 'disabled' : ''}>${C.busy ? '<span class="soa-spin"></span>' : ''} ${esc(T('Save remark'))}</button></div>
        </div>`;
    }

	function renderOpen() {
		const card = $root.querySelector(`[data-card="${CSS.escape(C.open)}"] .soa-cc-form`);
		const it = item(C.open);
		if (card && it) card.innerHTML = formHtml(it);
	}

    function save() {
        const it = item(C.open);
        if (!it || C.busy) return;
        C.busy = true; renderOpen();
        api('coll_remark', { list: C.data.list.name, item: it.name, note: C.form.note || '' })
            .then((list) => {
                C.busy = false; C.data.list = list; C.open = '';
                toast(T('Remark saved'), 'ok');
                render();
            }).catch((error) => { C.busy = false; renderOpen(); toast(errText(error), 'bad'); });
    }

	build();
})();
